module.purpose: A React hook for creating live database queries with reactive updates, supporting multiple input formats including query functions, configuration objects, and pre-created collections.
module.summary: This file exports the `useLiveQuery` hook from @tanstack/db, a React hook that creates reactive live queries with automatic subscription management. It provides 8 function overloads supporting different input patterns: query builder functions, config objects, and pre-created collections. The hook uses React's useSyncExternalStore for proper subscription handling and manages collection lifecycle with garbage collection. It returns state, data, collection, and various status flags (isLoading, isReady, isError, etc.) for consuming components.
module.businessContext: Enables real-time reactive data fetching in React applications. Failure breaks live data synchronization, causing stale UI data and missed updates in collaborative or frequently-changing datasets.

detail.name: useLiveQuery
detail.signature: useLiveQuery(queryFn: (q: QueryBuilder) => Query, deps?: any[]): { data: any[] | null, isLoading: boolean, isError: boolean, status: string }
detail.returnType: { data: any[] | null, isLoading: boolean, isError: boolean, status: string }
preconditions: queryFn must be a valid function that accepts a QueryBuilder and returns a Query
deps (if provided) must be an array of dependency values controlling re-run
Must be called within a React component or custom hook context
postconditions: Returns an object with data, isLoading, isError, and status fields
data contains the query result array or null when not yet resolved
isLoading is true while the query is being fetched
isError is true when the query fails
status reflects the current lifecycle state of the subscription
invariants: Re-executes query when any element in deps array changes (React dependency array semantics)
data is null before the first successful query resolution
edgeCases: Empty deps array: query runs once on mount, does not re-run
deps array with changing values: query re-runs on each deps change
queryFn returns a query with .from(), .where(), .join(), .select() patterns
Query failure sets isError to true and populates status accordingly

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: If queryFn is not a function, the hook will error at runtime
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Returns object with isError: true and status reflecting the error state
